notes: On the host path, kind 1 passes zero for a,b,c,d,start and kind 2 passes zero for c,d in host/native/extent.lisp lookup calls. Those fields are absent from the respective token and are dead for those kinds; decoded kind 3 retains a,b,c,d,start. Drop the dead fields from the representation and restate fn-xc-lookup-hit-is-the-descriptor per kind. The :duplicate install answer is the interim all-kind guard against binding one ledger charge to two slots.

S/P ruling: admitted install answers exclude both :refused and :duplicate. The original exact descriptor lookup contract remains unchanged; do not silently canonicalize an arbitrary preexisting table.
